alphas.name: alpha_0001
alphas.rationale: Low-turnover premium: neglected, low-churn names earn more; hot high-turnover names are crowded and overpriced.

alphas.name: alpha_0002
alphas.rationale: Relative turnover spike: recent churn vs own baseline; attention spikes mark local tops.

alphas.name: alpha_0003
alphas.rationale: Turnover coefficient of variation: erratic trading interest signals speculative churn; stable interest is healthier.

alphas.name: alpha_0004
alphas.rationale: Price-volume agreement: rallies confirmed by volume are crowded retail chases in A-shares; fade them.

alphas.name: alpha_0005
alphas.rationale: Time-series variant of price-volume agreement using own history ranks instead of cross-sectional ranks.

alphas.name: alpha_0006
alphas.rationale: Smart-money proxy: if turnover concentrates on up-days, retail is chasing; institutions accumulate quietly on down days.

alphas.name: alpha_0007
alphas.rationale: MAX effect (Bali et al.): the best single day in the past month proxies lottery demand; overpriced afterwards.

alphas.name: alpha_0008
alphas.rationale: Return skewness: right-skewed lottery payoffs are overvalued; negative-skew names carry a premium.

alphas.name: alpha_0009
alphas.rationale: Earnings yield (PIT TTM net income / market cap), ranked and industry-neutralized; within-sector cheapness.

alphas.name: alpha_0010
alphas.rationale: Cumulative overnight gap: A-share overnight returns are retail-sentiment-driven and revert; persistent gappers underperform.

alphas.name: alpha_0011
alphas.rationale: Cumulative intraday return: the intraday leg carries the speculative push that mean-reverts at monthly scale.

alphas.name: alpha_0012
alphas.rationale: Days since the 60d high: fresher highs mean crowded chasing (reversal risk); stale highs mean capitulation has run its course.

alphas.name: alpha_0013
alphas.rationale: Close-vs-VWAP persistent premium: closing auctions pushed above the day's average price signal aggressive late buying that fades. Probe: microstructure, not standard intuition.

alphas.name: alpha_0014
alphas.rationale: R1 found overnight gaps are momentum (sign flip); express it directly at quarterly scale, longer than the accepted 20d version to reduce overlap.

alphas.name: alpha_0015
alphas.rationale: Leg-decomposed volatility: overnight-gap vol isolates news/sentiment risk; calm-overnight names should carry the low-vol premium more purely than whole-day vol.

alphas.name: alpha_0016
alphas.rationale: Up/down semivol asymmetry: upside-dominated vol = lottery payoffs (fade), downside-dominated vol = distress premium (hold).

alphas.name: alpha_0017
alphas.rationale: Days since the turnover peak: fresh attention spikes mark tops; long-faded attention marks neglect premium.

alphas.name: alpha_0018
alphas.rationale: Demeaned-rank interaction (low corr with both parents by construction): is intraday reversal stronger among low-turnover neglected names?

alphas.name: alpha_0019
alphas.rationale: Lottery conditioned on attention: MAX effect should be strongest where turnover just spiked (retail arrived).

alphas.name: alpha_0020
alphas.rationale: Operating-cash-flow yield, industry-neutral: harder to manage than earnings; memory says EP survived where BP died, so test the cash version of E.
